title: IS12:: capitaltable.c (4.9)

lines.code: The growth of capital over years
int year = 1, how_many_years; /* years the capital stays in bank */
lines.explanation: Variable year is the loop counter. It is initialized to 1. It will be incremented in each iteration of the loop, so it can always tell how many times the loop was executed.

lines.code: float interest_rate; /* interest rate in percents */
float annual_interest; /* annual interest in dollars */

lines.explanation: This is a prompt for entering capital
This scanf statements reads an floating point value from the user and places it inside variable interest_rate
This is the beginning of the foolprof input loop. Unless the input is permissable (positive integer), we will stay in the loop asking the user for positive integer again and again.
This is a prompt for entering years to stay in bank.
This sentence reads integer value and places it into the variable how_many_years
This condition guarantee that we leave the loop with positive value of how_many_years. This is required for correct execution of the following do while loop.
This do while loop will be executed at least once since there is no condition check upon entrance
This statement adds the annual interest (right side) to the current value of capital. We can also write it shorter: capital += annual_interest;
This printing inside the loop produced a table (with one line for each loop iteration)

The loop will be executed once for each value of year - from 1 to how_many_years (i.e. exactly how_many_years times). When year will become how_many_years+1 the loop condition will be falce (==0) and we will exit
This is the first statement after the loop. Here the execusion will resume when checking the expression controlling the loop we will find that it became zero.
